acceptance: The module that sets ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL is identified
The variable is set before the test session starts, or the guard allowlists it with a documented reason
Corpus unit tests pass in an environment with the cloud extras installed
context: Reproduced on 2026-10-04 in worktree BenchBox.wt-publish-validated-cloud-tpcdi (environment with cloud extras) against BenchBox.wt-throughput-runs (clean environment), both at develop 061fac04d. Contributors with the cloud extras installed see spurious local failures.
description: In an environment with the cloud extras installed (Snowflake connector, thrift and others), `tests/unit/scripts/test_corpus_cohort_depth.py` errors at teardown with `test leaked process state past teardown (restored): env[ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL]`. Under xdist it hits the first test in each worker (5 errors); serially it hits one. The same tests pass (29/29) in an environment synced without the cloud extras. Some import in the cloud dependency chain sets the variable the first time it loads, and the guard blames whichever test runs then.
